This is registry-scoped identity alignment, not a full-paper census or proof of the original curator's chosen presentation. Inputs are unchanged.
shared_qualifications: C1 (conditional reference conversion only): Corrtest specifies saturated-KCl SCE = +0.241 V versus NHE at 25 C (https://www.corrtestinstruments.com/en/02437.html). The illustrative comparison is E_mV(SCE,25 C) = 1000*E_V(SHE) - 241, or E_mV(SHE) - 241. Apply the offset separately to both scatter endpoints. The paper reports SHE and a 27 C test bath, without establishing the CRA reference-cell temperature/calibration. Therefore links are not_comparable for a definitive potential comparison; the 25 C calculations are conditional and no offset was fitted to CRA.

Figure 3 (PDF p.3) means are based on at least three determinations; bars are total scatter, not standard deviations. Figures 12 and 15 repeat the standard-procedure bars. Table 2 Epit values (PDF p.7) are possible repeated standard-condition presentations, not identified replicate means or proven identical runs. obs_001/016 through obs_006/021 share CRA rows on this basis; do not double count them.

C2: 3 V/hour * 1000/3600 = 0.833333 mV/s, consistent with CRA 0.833. The standard solution is N2-deaerated 1 N H2SO4 + 0.5 M NaCl at 27 C. Source bulk pH is near 0.5 (PDF p.3), versus CRA 0.0; it is not inferred from acid normality.

Table 1 Ferrite Numbers are not established wt% phase fractions; CRA microstructure percentages are not used as exact composition evidence. Modified rapid-scan and chloride-free-loop results remain distinct from the standard test.
